column_description: A BIGSERIAL PK for market stats (e.g., 112233).
A DECIMAL(6,4) funding rate for futures (e.g., '0.0100').
A TIMESTAMP for next or recent funding event (e.g., '2025-05-11 08:00:00').
A NUMERIC(13,3) total market cap or size (e.g., '125000000.000').
A NUMERIC(13,3) maximum supply if applicable (e.g., '21000000.000').
A DECIMAL(13,3) market dominance or share (e.g., '45.000').
An INTEGER rank for volume or liquidity (e.g., 2).
A DECIMAL(8,2) volatility or fluctuation rating (e.g., '35.50').
A BIGINT FK to MarketData(MarketDataNode), associating stats with a snapshot.
